d:
The construction of *Package-04* of the *114 Km Jabalpur Outer Ring Road Project* is making steady progress. In this Ground Report, we cover the latest construction status from *Chainage KM 75+480,* including the progress of *GSB work, NH-30 crossing, Rail Over Bridge (ROB), Black Top sections, & the upcoming Major Toll Plaza.*
Package-04 is approximately *24 Km long* & connects *Kushner to Amjhar Road,* providing direct connectivity to *Dumna Airport* while helping heavy vehicles bypass Jabalpur city.
In this video you'll see:
• Ground Reality of Package-04
• NH-30 Crossing
